newsitem.title: UK: World sugar seen with limited upside potential - Man.
newsitem.headline: World sugar seen with limited upside potential - Man.

text.p: The upside potential for world sugar prices is still limited despite a reduction in the overall statistical surplus, trade house E D & F Man said in its latest monthly report on Tuesday.

Raw sugar values could be pressured after the nearby May expiry as new southern hemisphere supplies from centre-south Brazil, Australia and South Africa combined with delayed Thai shipments to boost availability.
But Russian raws demand could also pick up with the recent imposition of a tax on white sugar, it said.
In white sugar, Man said current dry weather concerns would support prices although in the longer term much would depend on the progress of European Union crops.

This season's surplus east European producers seemed unwilling to sell and were storing their surpluses in the hope that planned area reductions would benefit balance sheets next year when lower crops were expected, it said.
